NovaMasteryLongshot.name: Longshot
NovaMasteryLongshot.description: Increases the cast range of Pinning Shot by 30%. Pinning Shot also increases the range of Nova's next Basic Attack by 2.

NovaCovertOps.name: Covert Ops
NovaCovertOps.description: After being Stealthed for 2 seconds, Pinning Shot's Slow is increased to 60% and costs no Mana. Bonus is lost after losing Stealth for 1 second.

NovaAdvancedCloaking.name: Advanced Cloaking
NovaAdvancedCloaking.description: After being Stealthed for 1 second, gain an additional 10% Movement Speed. While Stealthed, regenerate 3 Mana per second.

NovaRapidProjection.name: Rapid Projection
NovaRapidProjection.description: Reduces Holo Decoy's cooldown and Mana cost by 60%.

NovaHoloStability.name: Holo Stability
NovaHoloStability.description: Increase the cast range of Holo Decoy by 100% and its duration by 120%. Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Ghost Protocol by 15 seconds.

NovaCovertMission.name: Covert Mission
NovaCovertMission.description: Enemy Minions killed near Nova grant a stack of Bribe. Hero Takedowns grant 10 stacks of Bribe. Use 25 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum of 100 stacks. If a camp is defeated entirely with Bribe, the camp respawns 50

NovaMasteryPerfectShotSnipe.name: Perfect Shot
NovaMasteryPerfectShotSnipe.description: Hitting an enemy with Snipe reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds and refunds half its Mana cost, doubled against enemy Heroes.

NovaCombatStyleOneintheChamber.name: One in the Chamber
NovaCombatStyleOneintheChamber.description: After using an Ability, Nova's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 65% additional damage.

NovaCombatStyleAntiArmorShells.name: Anti-Armor Shells
NovaCombatStyleAntiArmorShells.description: Nova's Basic Attacks deal 250% damage and decrease the Physical Armor of Heroic targets by 15 for 3 seconds, but her Attack Speed is proportionally slower.

NovaHeroicAbilityTripleTap.name: Triple Tap
NovaHeroicAbilityTripleTap.description: Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 (+4% per level) damage each.

NovaHeroicAbilityPrecisionStrike.name: Precision Strike
NovaHeroicAbilityPrecisionStrike.description: After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.

NovaMasteryPsionicEfficiency.name: Psionic Efficiency
NovaMasteryPsionicEfficiency.description: Snipe's range is increased by 15% and hitting a Hero grants an additional stack of Precision Sniper.

NovaMasteryDoubleTap.name: Double Tap
NovaMasteryDoubleTap.description: Pinning Shot now has 2 charges, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

NovaIonicForceField.name: Ionic Force Field
NovaIonicForceField.description: Gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds after losing Stealth.

NovaMasteryExplosiveShot.name: Explosive Round
NovaMasteryExplosiveShot.description: Snipe also deals 90% damage to enemies near the impact.

NovaMasteryCripplingShot.name: Crippling Shot
NovaMasteryCripplingShot.description: Pinning Shot lowers a Hero's Armor by 20 for the duration of the Slow, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

NovaMasteryLethalDecoy.name: Lethal Decoy
NovaMasteryLethalDecoy.description: Increases the damage Holo Decoy deals to 30% of Nova's damage.

NovaMasteryFastReload.name: Fast Reload
NovaMasteryFastReload.description: Triple Tap's cooldown is reset if it kills an enemy Hero.

NovaMasteryPrecisionBarrage.name: Precision Barrage
NovaMasteryPrecisionBarrage.description: Precision Strike gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

NovaApolloSuit.name: Apollo Suit
NovaApolloSuit.description: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 2 seconds.

GenericTalentRewind.name: Rewind
GenericTalentRewind.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.
